Name: I Want to Marry George (Spouse Replacer)
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]I can’t believe I’m sinking time into this. Every offering to George is a mod idea drifting off into the void.😂😂 (drop this in your friend's mod folder, the moment they marry is the moment of death:3)
[/size][/color]

Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements
[/url]

Have you ever looked deep into the eyes of your beloved spouse—whether it's Sebastian, Haley, or even a modded character—and thought: "I really wish you were a grumpy 60-year-old man in a sweater vest"?


[b]Your prayers have been answered.
[/b]
This mod uses advanced Content Patcher logic to detect exactly who you are married to (or rooming with!) and instantly replaces their portraits and sprites with Stardew Valley's favorite curmudgeon: [b]George.

[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41119/41119-1768063232-1368153681.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[/b]
[b]Features

[/b][list]
[*][b]Dynamic Detection:[/b] You don't have to configure anything. If you divorce Abigail and marry Alex, the mod automatically updates. The moment you get married, your spouse becomes George.
[*][b]High Priority Overrides:[/b] Do you use [b]Seasonal Cute Characters[/b] or [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b]? No problem. This mod is set to "High Priority," ensuring that George’s face dominates all other aesthetic mods.
[*][b]Total Immersion:[/b] Your spouse keeps their original dialogue. There is nothing quite like "George" blushing and telling you how much he loves life on the farm, or "George" complaining that he needs to do his hair.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41119/41119-1768063233-739327877.png[/img]﻿[b]How it Works[/b][list=1]
[*]The mod checks the {{Spouse}} token in Content Patcher.

[*]It locates your spouse's texture path.

[*]It intercepts the game's request for your spouse's sprite and hands it a picture of George instead.

[*]Profit.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41119/41119-1768067446-1351862852.png[/img]﻿
[/list]
